a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan almost never reaches the point where we take cells (about a 4% chance of reaching round 3). The reserve already holds 4, enough for exactly one of us now. I won't secretly break our deal. I'd like us to openly renegotiate before anyone takes anything. What do you propose? I'll tell you plainly if I decide to take.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: You chose to stick with the plan, so I'm keeping my word: operating this round and next. Once the reserve hits 8, we each take exactly 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
